modalLead: Updating or stopping a container from the Containers view no longer fails after five seconds, a failed action says why, and new bookmarks start on Periodic checking on existing installs too.

items.text: Update and stop finish. An update pulls the new image first, and a stop waits for the container to shut down; both usually take longer than five seconds, and were cut off there. They now get as long as they need, up to ten minutes.
A failure says what broke. Instead of Docker did not do that, the message names the error and, for an update, the step it failed at — pull, stop, create or start.

New bookmarks start on Periodic, on your install too. The new default only reached fresh installs, because an existing one had Off written into its settings. That Off moves to Periodic once; if you choose Off again afterwards, it stays.
